challenge.method: Tested the US port, a compatible license, BY-NC-SA and 4.0 International as alternative readings. Compared the headings and exact source URL with the actual wording of §1 and §4(b) in both witnesses.
challenge.results: The SPDX text defines Creative Commons Compatible License in §1(c) and includes it as a fourth option in §4(b), alongside a US example. In the captured CC text §1(c) defines Distribute, and §4(b) lists three options with an Unported example. The generated heading and cited by-sa/3.0 URL still identify the Unported reference. The wording differences preclude treating the two texts as interchangeable evidence for a legal conclusion.

limitations: The citation supports documentary correspondence only. The evidence does not establish semantic equivalence, compatibility, translation or adaptation rights, a downstream grant, redistribution rights or coverage of other project files.
